name: astro
description: Production Zerops deployment recipes, multi-service topologies, Astro Actions with NATS RPC, and Directus Content Layer loaders for Astro 5 SSR

zerops_yaml_astro.description: Production zerops.yaml for Astro 5 SSR on Bun 1.3.9 with Directus, NATS, Valkey, and PostgreSQL
zerops_yaml_astro.yaml:
zerops:
  - setup: astro
    build:
      os: alpine
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates
        - bun install --frozen-lockfile
        - bun run build
      deployFiles:
        - dist
        - node_modules
        - package.json
      cache:
        - node_modules
    run:
      os: alpine
      prepareCommands:
        - sudo apk add --no-cache curl ca-certificates tzdata
      start: bun ./dist/server/entry.mjs
      ports:
        - port: 3000
          httpSupport: true
      envVariables:
        HOST: "0.0.0.0"
        PORT: "3000"
        ASTRO_KEY: "${ASTRO_KEY}"
        PUBLIC_DIRECTUS_URL: "https://cms.yourdomain.com"
        DIRECTUS_URL: "http://directus:8055"
        NATS_URL: "${nats_url}"
        VALKEY_URL: "${cache_connectionString}"
        DATABASE_URL: "${db_connectionString}"

directus_content_loader.description: Custom Directus Content Layer loader for Astro 5 src/content.config.ts
